calculator_engine: function genericBrokerage(tv,rate,flat,type){const brok=flat>0?flat:tv*rate/100;const stt=type.includes('Delivery')?tv*0.001:type.includes('Options')?tv*0.000625:tv*0.00025;const exchCharge=tv*0.0000345;const gst=(brok+exchCharge)*0.18;const sebi=tv*0.000001;const total=brok+stt+gst+sebi;return{brokerage:brok,stt,gst,sebi,total,breakevenPct:(total/tv*100).toFixed(3)};}
